story.iWant: to import my complete historical game data from gomafia.pro
story.soThat: I can see my full game history and analytics in the platform

tasks.task: Implement profile page scraper for discovery (AC: #1)
Implement batch processing for large datasets (AC: #2)
Implement progress tracking and real-time updates (AC: #1)
Implement rate limiting for respectful scraping (AC: #2)

criterion.given: I am logged in and have a gomafia.pro profile URL
criterion.then: - Accepts gomafia.pro profile URL or player ID as input - Validates URL format and verifies profile exists on gomafia.pro - Initiates background import process for all available historical data - Scrapes player profile page to discover total games and date range - Processes games in chronological order (oldest first) or reverse chronological (newest first) - Imports all entities: Player, Games, Tournaments, Clubs, Judges, Statistics - Stores imported data in database with proper relationships - Tracks import progress (percentage complete, current game number, estimated time remaining) - Displays progress in real-time on import status page

- Handles large datasets (1000+ games) without timeout or memory issues - Rate limiting to avoid overwhelming gomafia.pro servers (respectful scraping) - Incremental progress updates (save checkpoint every N games) - Error handling for individual game failures (log and continue)

docs.doc: System can import historical game data from gomafia.pro. Users can view import progress in real-time. System validates imported data quality with ≥98% accuracy threshold.

Use Playwright for browser automation. Existing scrapers in src/lib/gomafia/scrapers/. Enforce 2-second delay between requests (30 requests per minute max). Use existing RateLimiter class. Store import status in sync_status table. Use existing CheckpointManager for checkpoint persistence. Use PostgreSQL advisory locks. Use existing AdvisoryLock wrapper. Lock key should include user_id to allow different users to import simultaneously.
Use TanStack Query for server state (import status polling). Configuration in src/lib/queryClient.ts. Use refetchInterval for real-time updates.

API request/response format patterns. Query parameters: Zod schema validation in route handler. Request body: JSON, validated with Zod. Success responses: Direct data or wrapped in { data: ... }. Error responses: { error: string, code: string, message: string }.

Testing patterns and standards. Unit tests for scrapers, parsers, orchestrator; integration tests for complete import flow; E2E tests for user journey (trigger import → view progress → completion); accessibility tests using axe-core.
WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance required, minimum 4.5:1 color contrast ratio for text.

docs.doc: Story acceptance criteria and technical notes. Use existing ImportOrchestrator class. Follow phase-based import pattern (Clubs → Players → Tournaments → Games → Statistics → Judges). Process games in batches of 50-100 for efficiency. Use existing BatchProcessor class.

Import logic in src/lib/gomafia/ directory following Clean Architecture patterns. Tests organized by type (unit/integration/e2e) with comprehensive coverage for all new scraping and import functionality.

artifact.reason: Core orchestrator class that coordinates all import phases. Manages checkpoints, validation, batch processing, progress tracking, and timeout enforcement. Contains phase-based import logic (CLUBS, PLAYERS, TOURNAMENTS, GAMES, STATISTICS, JUDGES).
Manages import checkpoints for resume capability. Cursor-based resumption pattern. Handles checkpoint save, load, and clear operations.

Batch processor for handling large datasets in memory-efficient chunks. Processes records in batches to avoid memory issues and enable checkpoint persistence. Default batch size: 100 records per batch.
Enforces rate limiting to respect gomafia.pro servers. Default: 2-second delay between requests (30 requests per minute max).
PostgreSQL advisory lock wrapper for concurrent import prevention. Lock key includes user_id to allow different users to import simultaneously.
Stores failed scraping operations. Logs errors to skipped_entities table for manual retry capability. Handles error classification and retry tracking.
Verifies referential integrity of imported relationships. Ensures foreign key relationships are valid after each phase.
Scraper for player profile pages. Can be extended to extract total games count and date range for import discovery.
Existing import API endpoint structure. Can be extended or used as reference for creating new import trigger endpoint.
API authentication middleware for verifying user context in import API endpoints. Returns user and role information.
TanStack Query configuration. Use refetchInterval for real-time progress updates.
ShadCN/UI Progress component for visual progress bar in import status UI.
Database model for tracking import status. Fields: progress, currentOperation, lastError, validationRate, totalRecordsProcessed, validRecords, invalidRecords.
Database model for import checkpoint persistence. Fields: currentPhase, currentBatch, lastProcessedId, processedIds, progress, isPaused.
Database model for storing failed scraping operations. Fields: phase, entityType, entityId, pageNumber, errorCode, errorMessage, errorDetails, retryCount, status.

constraint.description: Clean Architecture + Hexagonal Architecture patterns. Domain layer cannot import application/adapters/infrastructure. Application layer cannot import adapters/infrastructure. Follow layer dependency rules.
Use existing ImportOrchestrator class. Follow phase-based import pattern (Clubs → Players → Tournaments → Games → Statistics → Judges). Process games in batches of 50-100 for efficiency.
Enforce 2-second delay between requests (30 requests per minute max) to respect gomafia.pro servers. Use existing RateLimiter class.
Use PostgreSQL advisory locks. Use existing AdvisoryLock wrapper. Lock key should include user_id to allow different users to import simultaneously.
Use Zod schemas for data validation. Existing validators in src/lib/gomafia/validators/ directory.
Use TanStack Query for server state (import status polling). Use refetchInterval for real-time updates. Configuration in src/lib/queryClient.ts.
Use ShadCN/UI components. Follow existing component patterns for forms and data display. Use Progress component for visual progress bar.
WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance required, minimum 4.5:1 color contrast ratio for text.

Maintain minimum 80% test coverage. TDD approach: Write tests before implementation. Include unit tests for scrapers and orchestrator, integration tests for import flow, E2E tests for complete import journey, accessibility tests using axe-core.
Use existing SkippedEntitiesManager to store failed scraping operations. Log errors to skipped_entities table for manual retry capability. Continue import after individual failures.

tests.standards: Maintain minimum 80% test coverage for all new code. Follow TDD approach: Write tests before implementation, follow Red-Green-Refactor cycle. Use Vitest for unit and integration tests, Playwright for E2E tests. Test types: Unit tests for scrapers, parsers, orchestrator; integration tests for complete import flow; E2E tests for user journey (trigger import → view progress → completion); accessibility tests using @axe-core/playwright for E2E accessibility testing, verify WCAG 2.1 AA compliance. Import flow testing: Test complete flow (trigger import → profile discovery → phase execution → progress tracking → completion), test error handling, test concurrent import prevention, test large dataset handling (1000+ games).

ideas.test: Test profile URL validation using Zod schema. Verify valid gomafia.pro URLs are accepted, invalid URLs are rejected.
Test profile existence verification. Mock Playwright page to verify profile page scraping for discovery.
Test complete import flow: Trigger import → Verify profile discovery → Verify phase execution → Verify progress tracking → Verify completion.
Test user journey: User triggers import → Views progress page → Sees real-time updates → Import completes.
Test accessibility of import status page using @axe-core/playwright. Verify WCAG 2.1 AA compliance.
Test large dataset import (1000+ games) with timeout prevention. Verify memory usage stays within limits.
Test rate limiting enforces 2-second delays. Verify rate limiting works across multiple scrapers.
Test error handling with individual game failures. Verify errors are logged correctly, import continues after individual failures, error summary is accurate.
Test concurrent import prevention. Verify concurrent imports are prevented, lock is released after completion, lock is released after failure.
Test chronological ordering option. Verify games process in correct order (oldest first or newest first), progress reflects ordering correctly.

Test database relationship integrity. Verify relationships are established correctly (Games reference valid Player IDs, Players reference valid Club IDs, Games reference valid Tournament IDs), integrity violations are detected.
